category: premium link generator / multi-host (Brazil, BRL) - closed

free_tier.stated: None. The live site is a closure notice: 'liberapremium chegou ao fim' (liberapremium has come to an end), 'Desde 2015', 'liberapremium • 2015 - 2026'.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: no service. The last indexed host table showed 1fichier and Mega as 'ilimitado' with a 1,000 KB/s ceiling on Mega, and Mediafire, Uploaded, Zippyshare and Uptobox marked 'OFF'.
per_object_cap.notes: Host statuses are from the search index's copy of the page, not from a live read; the live page no longer serves them.

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage, and the operation has ended.

egress.terms: No terms remain. The last indexed price table sold access by period: '1 Dia R$ 3,99', '30 Dias R$ 16,90', '60 Dias R$ 28,99', '90 Dias R$ 50,70', '180 Dias R$ 101,40'.

interface_detail: The service is gone, so the interface is historical: a web generator. No API appears in the indexed copy.
tooling: None. Any client still pointed at it fails.
chaining: Nothing to chain. Its value now is as the failure mode of the Brazilian generator market: a 2015-vintage generator with ten years of operation closed in 2026, so a prepaid 180-day term bought in late 2025 bought less than half of what it promised.

limits.value: historical: 'ilimitado' on 1fichier, 1,000 KB/s on Mega, and four of the ten listed hosts already dead when the page was indexed

limits_note: The indexed page shows the structural problem without any enforcement data: half the host table was 'OFF'. A generator that resells host access loses a host whenever the host changes its API or blocks the reseller's IP range.
binding_note: Historical. The binding constraint was never reached because the service ended first, which is itself the finding.

identity_cost.detail: Not applicable now. The indexed copy implies a registration, as every Brazilian generator requires one.

reliability_note: Closed in 2026 after eleven years. The farewell page gives no reason and offers no migration path or refund channel: 'Obrigado a todos que participaram durante esse tempo todo'.
confidence_note: The closure was read live on the vendor's own domain today, which is the strongest possible evidence for a dead verdict. Prices are reported only: they survive in the search index's copy of the page, and the live page does not serve them.

evidence.proved: the live closure notice: title 'liberapremium chegou ao fim', 'Desde 2015', 'Foram anos de historias, momentos, amizades e muita dedicacao', 'liberapremium • 2015 - 2026'

the search index's copy of the same URL, still showing the price table (1 Dia R$ 3,99 through 180 Dias R$ 101,40) and a host table with Dropbox, Mediafire, Uploaded, Zippyshare and Uptobox marked 'OFF' - proof that an indexed snippet can outlive the page it describes

notes: Any lane that prices Brazilian generators from snippets alone will quote a service that no longer exists. The live read is what settled it.
